subject: Clearsight SIG kickoff — clarifying hosting, residency, and ownership
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearsight SIG kickoff — clarifying hosting, residency, and ownership

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and three clarifying asks so we can scope the SIG work and get the right owners looped in:

Recap:
- Goal: complete SIG/CAIQ or a short custom form and deliver SOC2 evidence where applicable.
- Priority items you flagged: data residency (EU vs US), customer data classification, and whether our hosted model processes PII.

Clarifying asks (can you confirm by EOD Tue?):
1) Hosting boundary: do you require Redwood to host in an EU region for production processing of EU customer data, or is EU data-at-rest sufficient?
2) Residency examples: which Clearsight product tenants in scope for the review (e.g., customer-facing inference API vs internal analytics)?
3) Point of contact for technical evidence: who provides network diagrams and SOC2 artifacts on your side?

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a lightweight SIG starter (CAIQ mapping) we typically use to mark quick wins.
- Priyom (cc) will follow up with a short technical checklist and suggest a 30-min tech sync once we confirm the in-scope tenants.

Thanks — want to keep momentum so we can get this into your procurement/infosec queue this week.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SIG_Starter_Form_CAIQ.xlsx (spreadsheet), clearsight_network_diagram.png (placeholder)

From: Alex Mercer <alex@clearsight.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Clearsight Security <security@clearsight.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearsight SIG kickoff — clarifying hosting, residency, and ownership

Neha — thanks for the summary and the starter sheet. Quick answers: 

- Hosting boundary: for new customer tenants, we prefer EU-hosted processing when customer data is classified as personal data; for existing tenants (legacy), EU-at-rest + contractual assurances are often acceptable. We can provide a list of tenant IDs by tomorrow.
- In-scope tenants: primarily the customer-facing inference cluster (prod inference), and one analytics tenant for evaluation (non-prod).
- Tech contact: looping in our security alias (security@clearsight.ai) — they own SOC2 artifacts; I'll also add James (infra) if needed for the network diagram.

Two follow-ups from us:
- We'll upload the current network diagram (it has some redactions) and our SOC2 checklist to your Drive link this afternoon.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood needs to run in a dedicated VPC for the EU-hosted option, or would your hosted offering with tenant isolation suffice?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform, Clearsight AI
alex@clearsight.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@clearsight.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearsight SIG kickoff — clarifying hosting, residency, and ownership

Thanks Alex — helpful. A few technical clarifications from the infra/security side to avoid back-and-forth during the SIG: 

1) EU hosting option: if you need EU-hosted processing for prod inference, we have two modes:
   - Hosted EU tenant (Redwood-managed, single-tenant logical isolation) — fastest path, no dedicated VPC.
   - Dedicated VPC / Private (customer-managed network, HSM/KMS integration) — requires a short provisioning lead time and a separate contract addendum.

2) Evidence ask list (what we’ll need from Clearsight):
   - Network diagram (layered: per-tenant ingress, egress, peering details) — redacted diagram is okay if it shows boundaries.
   - SOC2 point-in-time report (PDF) and description of scope (which systems/users were in-scope).
   - Data classification mapping for the tenants (CSV or doc).

3) Mapping SIG to artifacts: we’ll prefill the SIG_Starter_Form with Redwood answers for common items (auth, encryption-at-rest) — we’ll then mark questions where your SOC2 or network docs serve as evidence.

Ask: Alex, can you confirm if your SOC2 excludes any of the evaluation pipelines (so we can flag gaps)? Also, if you can upload the network diagram to the Drive link in my first email, I’ll drop in comments with exact evidence mapping.

Proposed cadence:
- Today: Clearsight uploads network diagram + SOC2 sample.
- Tomorrow: Redwood pre-fills SIG starter and sends a short evidence mismatch list.
- Wed: 30-min tech sync to resolve outstanding items and decide hosting option.

If EU dedicated VPC is required and you want KMS integration, I'll include Kimberly on the sync to discuss provisioning lead times and contract notes.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.inference

- We’ll prefill SIG_Starter_Form_CAIQ.xlsx and drop inline comments where we need more detail.
- Tech sync: available slots Wed 2027-09-01 09:00-10:00 PT or 15:00-16:00 PT — which works for you and James?

If you prefer the dedicated VPC route for EU-hosted prod, Kim (cc) will outline provisioning time and a short addendum to the contract during the sync. Otherwise, we can proceed with Redwood-managed EU tenancy and minimal onboarding.

Thanks — moving to set up the conference invite once you confirm the slot and upload artifacts.
